module.purpose: Provides public snapshot capture and restoration for a tldraw editor store, combining document data with session state while preserving editor-managed instance properties.
module.summary: This module defines the editor snapshot shapes and coordinates loading or capturing them. Loading accepts either a complete editor snapshot or a legacy store snapshot, migrates legacy data, filters it to document-scoped records, preserves selected instance and session state, and applies document and UI state atomically. Capturing reads the current document and cached session state and rejects access before session initialization.
module.businessContext: Supports persistence, duplication, import, and restoration of tldraw editor documents and UI state. Failure can prevent documents from loading or snapshots from being saved consistently.

TLLoadSnapshotOptions (~L18-27): Configures whether session flags are overwritten during loading

getSnapshot (~L96-107): Captures document and initialized session state from a store

mutationOfArg: Mutates the supplied TLStore by loading snapshots and updating instance and session records.

units.name: loadSnapshot

detail.name: loadSnapshot
detail.signature: export function loadSnapshot(store: TLStore, _snapshot: Partial<TLEditorSnapshot> | TLStoreSnapshot, opts?: TLLoadSnapshotOptions)
preconditions: _snapshot is either a partial TLEditorSnapshot or a TLStoreSnapshot.
postconditions: If the input is a legacy TLStoreSnapshot, it is migrated and only document-scoped records are loaded.
If snapshot.document is present, the document state is loaded into the store.
Editor-preserving instance state is restored after document loading when available.
Previously cached session state is restored when available.
If snapshot.session is present, its session state is loaded, with forceOverwrite controlled by opts?.forceOverwriteSessionState.
All state loading and restoration occurs within one store atomic operation.
invariants: Preserving instance state is applied after document state loading.
Preserving cached session state is applied before the requested snapshot.session state.
A legacy snapshot is not loaded directly without successful schema migration.
Non-document records from a migrated legacy store snapshot are excluded.
edgeCases: A legacy TLStoreSnapshot whose migration succeeds is converted into a document snapshot using the current serialized schema and filtered document records.
A legacy TLStoreSnapshot whose migration fails throws an Error and does not proceed to the atomic loading operation.
A partial TLEditorSnapshot without document state does not load document state, but still preserves available instance and cached session state.
A partial TLEditorSnapshot without session state does not overwrite session state from the input snapshot.
When forceOverwriteSessionState is absent or false, snapshot.session loading uses the default overwrite behavior; when true, it passes forceOverwrite: true.

raises: Error when store.schema.migrateStoreSnapshot returns a non-success result

stateMutations: Mutates the supplied TLStore document state when snapshot.document is present.
Mutates the supplied TLStore instance state to restore preserved properties.
Mutates the supplied TLStore session state to restore cached and requested session state.
detail.summary: Loads document and optional session state into a TLStore while preserving editor-managed instance and cached session state. Legacy store snapshots are migrated and filtered to document-scoped records before loading.

specLiterals.role: Prefix of the error raised when legacy store snapshot migration fails.

specTests.when: loadSnapshot is called with that snapshot.
specTests.then: The migrated schema and only document-scoped records are loaded; non-document records are excluded.
It throws an Error whose message begins with "Failed to migrate store snapshot: invalid snapshot".

specTests.when: loadSnapshot is called with opts.forceOverwriteSessionState set to true.
specTests.then: The document is loaded, preserved instance and cached session state are restored, and the supplied session state is loaded with forceOverwrite enabled.

detail.name: getSnapshot
preconditions: The provided store is a valid TLStore.
Session state for the store has been initialized and is available.
postconditions: Returns an object containing the store snapshot under document and the current session state under session.
The returned document is obtained from the provided store.
The returned session is the current value of the store's cached session-state signal.
invariants: The returned snapshot contains both document and session properties.
The session state is read from the signal associated with the provided store.
edgeCases: When the session-state signal has no current value, the function throws an Error instead of returning a partial snapshot.
When session state is available, the function returns the current store snapshot and session state without indicating an error.
